basic_details.job_title: BMC X-Ray Technician Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Brihanmumbai Mahanagarpalika (बृहन्मुंबई महानगरपालिका), through its Public Health Department, requires an X-Ray technician on contract basis for the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) of Shivaji Nagar Maternity Home, Govandi. Applications, with rates for the service, go in a sealed envelope to the Medical Officer, Shivaji Nagar Maternity Home, 3rd Floor, Ahilyabai Holkar Marg, Shivaji Nagar, Govandi (West)-400043, from 19 November 2026 to 26 November 2026, during office hours from 10:30 AM to 05:00 PM. The applicant must have a Municipal Corporation vendor number.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is submitted in a sealed envelope at this office: Medical Officer, Shivaji Nagar Maternity Home, 3rd Floor, Ahilyabai Holkar Marg, Shivaji Nagar, Govandi (West)-400043. Prepare the application together with your rates, that is, the service charges for X-ray film (8X10), Developer Chemical, Fixer Chemical etc. needed to take and prepare the X-ray of a newborn. Note that the technician brings the X-ray film himself, so the rates cover the film and chemicals as well as the service. Put the application and the rates in a sealed envelope. Submit the envelope at the office above between 19 November 2026 and 26 November 2026, during office hours from 10:30 AM to 05:00 PM. The notice does not prescribe an application form or a postal mode. Applications received will be opened in the office (chamber) of the Medical Officer (I/C), Shivajinagar Maternity Home.

content_sections.heading: BMC X-Ray technician Job Description
content_sections.text: Take and prepare X-rays of newborns in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit. Bring the X-ray film himself for the work.

content_sections.text: Rates (service charges) for 1. X-ray film (8X10), 2. Developer Chemical, 3. Fixer Chemical etc., in the sealed envelope.
